{{Quote|I'm a little busy at the moment&hellip; making disease-resistant clothing and other high-quality garb for Jabba's elite forces.|Palu Zerk, to a passerby|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Palu Zerk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] townsperson from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the older sister of [[Feinu Zerk]], both of whom ended up working for [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Working from her [[Palu's shop|shop]] in the small [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]], Palu tailored specially designed [[Disease/Legends|disease-resistant]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and other high-quality garbs exclusively for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] elite forces. Her sister, working as a delivery [[Courier/Legends|courier]], would then deliver this equipment to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] elite guard. During one of her deliveries, Palu's sister found herself ambushed by thugs of the rival [[Valarian Syndicate]], who attempted to kidnap her and hold her for [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]]. Before they could follow through with their plan, Feinu was rescued by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] dispatched by Palu. For rescuing her younger sister, Palu bestowed to the heroic individual a [[Treated Protective Coverall]], which the spacer used to acquire [[Sarlacc bile|bile]] from the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]], an essential ingredient used to construct the [[Zicx-bug bomb]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You want my help? Then you help me, first. The palace scouts say that my sister left to come back here several hours ago... but she hasn't shown up. I fear the worst. Can you run to the edge of town and see if you can find my sister? Bring her back here to me?"<br />"Your sister?"<br />"Feinu. She runs errands for me. Mostly she delivers new equipment to Jabba's elite guard. Jabba and I have an agreement of sorts. The road from here to there is pretty dangerous. Valarian is always trying to mess things up. I worry that they have done something bad to Feinu. Will you go find her for me?"<br />"Yes. I will find her and bring her back here unharmed.|Palu Zerk and a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
As the older sister of [[Feinu Zerk]], Palu Zerk was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="AED" /> townsperson from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="JTL" /> During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], both Palu and her sister ended up in the small [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="AED" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the two sisters formed a business agreement with the [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal enterprise]] led by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Palu also established a friendship with another fellow criminal who worked for Jabba, a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] named [[Jowir Ar'Lensa]]. Working from her [[Palu's shop|shop]] in Wayfar, Palu tailored specially designed [[Disease/Legends|disease-resistant]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and other high-quality garbs exclusively for Jabba's elite forces. Feinu would then deliver this newly created equipment to Jabba's elite guard on the short, yet dangerous road from Wayfar to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. Feinu traveled the road alone, despite her older sister's objections. Their arrangement drew attention and ire from Jabba's rival, [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]]. During one of her treks back from the palace, Feinu ended up running late. When Palu learned from the palace [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] that she had left to come back several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] ago, she began to fear the worst, and rightly assumed that the [[Valarian Syndicate]] may be involved in her disappearance.<ref name="AED" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
Fortunately for Palu, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] referred to her by Jowir Ar'Lensa agreed to search the edge of town to locate her sister. As it turned out, Feinu was indeed ambushed by a group of three Valarian thugs directed by a Valarian [[Swooper/Legends|swooper]] leader. The Valarian thugs warned Feinu that if she moved, they would disintegrate her on the spot. She screamed for help as the gang attempted to kidnap her and hold her for [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]]. Before they could follow through with their plan, however, the spacer dispatched by Palu spotted the troubled young lady, and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the four thugs who were attacking her. Feinu thanked her rescuer, and as the spacer escorted her back to Palu's shop in Wayfar, she vowed to one [[Standard day/Legends|day]] enact revenge against the Valarian swoopers. Once Feinu was safely back in town, her older sister expressed her sincerest gratitude. In thanks, she provided the spacer some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a [[Treated Protective Coverall]], a special suit which was resistant to disease. The spacer required such a suit in order to acquire corrosive [[Sarlacc bile|bile]] from the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]. The spacer required the bile as a constructive component for the [[Zicx-bug bomb]]. However, gifting the spacer such a suit was an especially risky prospect for Palu. Because of her exclusive agreement with Jabba's elite guard, Palu knew that if Jabba found out that she gave the suit away, the Hutt crime lord would have the two of them killed. For this reason, she urged the spacer to leave her be, despite being grateful to individual for saving her younger sister.<ref name="AED" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|They caught me on the way back from the palace. My sister says I shouldn't walk the road to Wayfar by myself. Valarian's thugs jumped me and told me they were going to hold me for ransom.|Feinu Zerk, to her rescuer|<ref name="AED" />}}
Palu Zerk had fair skin, brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Somewhat standoffish, Palu would at times turn away passers by whenever she was busy making her specially designed clothing for Jabba's elite forces. If someone she did not know approached her, she would direct the individual to her friend Jowir, who she claimed loved meeting new people. Palu was particularly protective of her younger sister. She disapproved of her making the journey to and from Jabba's Palace alone, rightly fearing that the rival Valarian gang could cause her trouble. When Feinu ran several hours late, Palu feared for her sister's welfare, and implored the spacer referred to her by Jowir to search the edge of town to find her. The spacer agreed, and Palu urged the individual to hurry. She did not appreciate any delay in locating her younger sister, and was willing to use her friendship with Jabba to her advantage if any harm befell her. Fortunately for the spacer tasked with the responsibility of rescuing the young lady, this would not be necessary. Feinu was duly located, and saved from the group of Valarian thugs. For saving her little sister, Palu expressed a great deal of gratitude, going so far as to provide the spacer a Treated Protective Coverall, designed exclusively for Jabba's people. She did this, despite knowing that Jabba would have her killed if he found out. However, Palu's generosity had limits. After she provided the spacer with the coverall and a few credits, she urged the individual to leave her alone, as she did not have anything left to give.<ref name="AED" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|When you return I will reward you with special disease-resistant equipment&hellip; none better in the galaxy. Now, please hurry!|Palu Zerk, to the spacer who rescued her sister|<ref name="AED" />}}
While working at her shop in Wayfar, Palu wore a flex-form [[shirt]] colored in shades of beige and gray. She also wore a similarly colored pleated skirt and gray dress slippers. Around her neck, she wore a [[Silver/Legends|silver]] colored elegant [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]]. As part of her agreement with Jabba the Hutt, Palu tailored specially designed disease-resistant clothing and other high-quality garbs for Jabba's elite forces.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Did you find her?"<br />"I can't do this anymore."<br />"Then I hope, for your sake&hellip; she's not hurt. Jabba helps me when I need him. I may need him to teach you a lesson. Do you understand?|Palu Zerk, threatening players who decided to abandon the quest|<ref name="AED" />}}
Palu Zerk was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> She was included as part of the [[W:c:swg:Zicx Bug Bomb quest|Zicx-bug bomb quest]],<ref name="AED" /> added to the game on [[August 12]], 2003.<ref name="Publish">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64185&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2003}}</ref> During one part of the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]], players were required to locate Feinu, save her from four [[W:c:swg:Valarian|Valarian]] thugs, and escort her safely back to Palu in the [[W:c:swg:City|town]] of [[W:c:swg:Wayfar|Wayfar]]. Completing this task would earn the player 100 [[W:c:swg:Imperial Credit|credits]] and a Treated Protective Coverall. The coverall could then be used for the next portion of the quest, allowing players to acquire [[W:c:swg:Jar of Sarlacc Bile|bile]] from the nearby [[W:c:swg:Sarlacc|sarlacc]] without suffering ill-effects. Palu's surname of Zerk never appeared in the game.<ref name="AED" /> However, the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide]]'' ([[2004]]) lists her full name as Palu Zerk. The reference guide also lists her as a townsperson found on [[W:c:swg:Rori|Rori]].<ref name="JTL" /> This attribute never appeared in the game, as Palu only appeared as part a quest issued on [[W:c:swg:Tatooine|Tatooine]]. Although the player could choose not to do the tasks associated with the Zicx-bug bomb quest, this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="AED" />
